tables.name: public.organizations
tables.comment: Tenant root. Single row today; every domain table hangs off organization_id for future multi-tenancy.

indexes.name: organizations_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX organizations_pkey ON public.organizations USING btree (id)

columns.name: timezone
columns.comment: IANA timezone driving availability math and notification formatting. Change with care: weekly hours are interpreted in this zone.

columns.name: tax_rate_bps
columns.comment: Sales tax in basis points (800 = 8%). Applied to taxable transaction items (retail); services are non-taxable in GA.

indexes.name: locations_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX locations_pkey ON public.locations USING btree (id)

tables.name: public.staff
tables.comment: Employees. Linked 1:1 to auth.users via user_id. Deactivated (active=false), never deleted. Self-editable personal fields are guarded by trg_guard_staff_self_update.

columns.name: bookable
columns.comment: Whether this person appears as a provider in scheduling (columns, qualification pickers, slot search).

indexes.name: staff_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX staff_pkey ON public.staff USING btree (id)

indexes.name: staff_user_id_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX staff_user_id_key ON public.staff USING btree (user_id)

constraints.name: staff_user_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

triggers.name: trg_guard_staff_self_update
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER trg_guard_staff_self_update BEFORE UPDATE ON public.staff FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_staff_self_update()

triggers.name: trg_last_super_admin_deactivation
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER trg_last_super_admin_deactivation BEFORE UPDATE ON public.staff FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_last_super_admin_deactivation()

indexes.name: staff_locations_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX staff_locations_pkey ON public.staff_locations USING btree (staff_id, location_id)

constraints.name: staff_locations_location_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (location_id) REFERENCES locations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: staff_locations_staff_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (staff_id) REFERENCES staff(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.name: public.roles
tables.comment: Role definitions. system=true rows (super_admin, admin, front_desk, provider) cannot be deleted.

indexes.name: roles_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX roles_pkey ON public.roles USING btree (id)

indexes.name: roles_organization_id_name_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX roles_organization_id_name_key ON public.roles USING btree (organization_id, name)

triggers.name: trg_protect_system_roles
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER trg_protect_system_roles BEFORE DELETE ON public.roles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_system_role_deletion()

tables.name: public.permissions
tables.comment: Permission catalog: domain.action(.own|.any) keys. Seeded in migration 1; code references keys as strings.

indexes.name: permissions_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX permissions_pkey ON public.permissions USING btree (key)

tables.name: public.role_permissions
tables.comment: The permission matrix as data. Changing a row changes app behavior everywhere with zero deploys.

indexes.name: role_permissions_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX role_permissions_pkey ON public.role_permissions USING btree (role_id, permission_key)

constraints.name: role_permissions_role_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (role_id) REFERENCES roles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: role_permissions_permission_key_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (permission_key) REFERENCES permissions(key) ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.name: public.staff_roles
tables.comment: Role assignments. Audit-logged by trigger; last-super-admin removal blocked by trigger.

indexes.name: staff_roles_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX staff_roles_pkey ON public.staff_roles USING btree (staff_id, role_id)

constraints.name: staff_roles_staff_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (staff_id) REFERENCES staff(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: staff_roles_role_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (role_id) REFERENCES roles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

triggers.name: trg_audit_staff_roles
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER trg_audit_staff_roles AFTER INSERT OR DELETE ON public.staff_roles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_staff_role_change()

triggers.name: trg_last_super_admin
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER trg_last_super_admin BEFORE DELETE ON public.staff_roles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_last_super_admin_removal()

tables.name: public.audit_log
tables.comment: Append-only. Inserts via service role / security-definer functions only. Includes health_note.viewed (app-layer, since SELECTs cannot fire triggers), appointment.booked, staff lifecycle events.

indexes.name: audit_log_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX audit_log_pkey ON public.audit_log USING btree (id)

tables.name: public.staff_invites
tables.comment: Tokenized invites (7-day expiry). Accepted atomically by accept_staff_invite() — service-role only. Partial unique index prevents duplicate pending invites per email.

indexes.name: staff_invites_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX staff_invites_pkey ON public.staff_invites USING btree (id)

indexes.name: staff_invites_token_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX staff_invites_token_key ON public.staff_invites USING btree (token)

indexes.name: staff_invites_one_pending
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX staff_invites_one_pending ON public.staff_invites USING btree (organization_id, lower(email)) WHERE ((accepted_at IS NULL) AND (revoked_at IS NULL))

tables.name: public.service_categories
tables.comment: Menu grouping (Massage, Facials, ...).

indexes.name: service_categories_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX service_categories_pkey ON public.service_categories USING btree (id)

indexes.name: service_categories_organization_id_name_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX service_categories_organization_id_name_key ON public.service_categories USING btree (organization_id, name)

tables.name: public.services
tables.comment: The treatment catalog. duration_minutes is client-facing; buffers extend the blocked window. Prices in cents. requires_intake gates booking once intake forms exist. Deactivated, never deleted.

columns.name: buffer_after_min
columns.comment: Cleanup/reset time appended to the blocked window; invisible to the client-facing times.

indexes.name: services_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX services_pkey ON public.services USING btree (id)

indexes.name: services_org_active
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX services_org_active ON public.services USING btree (organization_id, active)

triggers.name: trg_services_touch
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER trg_services_touch BEFORE UPDATE ON public.services FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION touch_updated_at()

tables.name: public.resource_types
tables.comment: Room categories services require (Massage Room, Facial Room, ...).

indexes.name: resource_types_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX resource_types_pkey ON public.resource_types USING btree (id)

indexes.name: resource_types_organization_id_name_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX resource_types_organization_id_name_key ON public.resource_types USING btree (organization_id, name)

tables.name: public.resources
tables.comment: Concrete rooms per location. Inactive rooms leave bookable inventory immediately.

indexes.name: resources_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX resources_pkey ON public.resources USING btree (id)

indexes.name: resources_location_id_name_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX resources_location_id_name_key ON public.resources USING btree (location_id, name)

tables.name: public.service_resource_requirements
tables.comment: Service -> room TYPE requirement; a concrete free room of the type is assigned at booking.

indexes.name: service_resource_requirements_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX service_resource_requirements_pkey ON public.service_resource_requirements USING btree (service_id, resource_type_id)

constraints.name: service_resource_requirements_service_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (service_id) REFERENCES services(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: service_resource_requirements_resource_type_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (resource_type_id) REFERENCES resource_types(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.name: public.service_staff
tables.comment: Qualification: who may perform what, with optional per-staff duration/price overrides that the slot and booking routes apply.

indexes.name: service_staff_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX service_staff_pkey ON public.service_staff USING btree (service_id, staff_id)

constraints.name: service_staff_staff_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (staff_id) REFERENCES staff(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: service_staff_service_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (service_id) REFERENCES services(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.name: public.clients
tables.comment: Spa clients (no auth accounts). no_show_count is maintained by trigger from appointment status changes. flags is an extensible jsonb for operational booleans (requires_card_on_file).

columns.name: flags
columns.comment: Operational booleans, extendable without migrations. Known keys: requires_card_on_file

indexes.name: clients_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX clients_pkey ON public.clients USING btree (id)

indexes.name: clients_org_name
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX clients_org_name ON public.clients USING btree (organization_id, last_name, first_name)

indexes.name: clients_org_email
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX clients_org_email ON public.clients USING btree (organization_id, lower(email))

triggers.name: trg_clients_touch
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER trg_clients_touch BEFORE UPDATE ON public.clients FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION touch_updated_at()

tables.name: public.client_notes
tables.comment: Tiered notes: preference | internal | health. HEALTH notes are RLS-gated to clients.notes.health.view and must be read through the audited server route (reads cannot fire triggers, so auditing lives at the app layer). Append-only.

indexes.name: client_notes_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX client_notes_pkey ON public.client_notes USING btree (id)

indexes.name: client_notes_client
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX client_notes_client ON public.client_notes USING btree (client_id, created_at DESC)

constraints.name: client_notes_client_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.name: public.availability_rules
tables.comment: Recurring weekly hours in LOCATION-LOCAL time (survives DST). Overlaps per staff/day are impossible: no_overlapping_hours exclusion constraint (timerange custom type).

indexes.name: availability_rules_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX availability_rules_pkey ON public.availability_rules USING btree (id)

indexes.name: availability_rules_staff
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX availability_rules_staff ON public.availability_rules USING btree (staff_id, day_of_week)

indexes.name: no_overlapping_hours
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX no_overlapping_hours ON public.availability_rules USING gist (staff_id, day_of_week, timerange(start_time, end_time))

constraints.name: availability_rules_staff_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (staff_id) REFERENCES staff(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: no_overlapping_hours
constraints.def: EXCLUDE USING gist (staff_id WITH =, day_of_week WITH =, timerange(start_time, end_time) WITH &&)

tables.name: public.availability_exceptions
tables.comment: Time off / sick / breaks (remove availability) and extra shifts (add it). requested -> approved/denied workflow; decisions notify the subject and new requests notify approvers via triggers.

indexes.name: availability_exceptions_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX availability_exceptions_pkey ON public.availability_exceptions USING btree (id)

indexes.name: availability_exceptions_staff
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX availability_exceptions_staff ON public.availability_exceptions USING btree (staff_id, starts_at)

constraints.name: availability_exceptions_staff_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (staff_id) REFERENCES staff(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

triggers.name: trg_notify_timeoff_decision
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER trg_notify_timeoff_decision AFTER UPDATE ON public.availability_exceptions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION notify_timeoff_decision()

triggers.name: trg_notify_timeoff_requested
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER trg_notify_timeoff_requested AFTER INSERT ON public.availability_exceptions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION notify_timeoff_requested()

tables.name: public.appointments
tables.comment: Never deleted — status lifecycle only (booked→confirmed→checked_in→in_progress→completed | cancelled | no_show). Double-booking of staff or rooms is impossible: gist exclusion constraints on the blocked window, which ignore cancelled/no_show rows so slots free themselves.

columns.name: blocked_from
columns.comment: Start of the FULL blocked window including buffer_before — what all conflict checks use.

indexes.name: appointments_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX appointments_pkey ON public.appointments USING btree (id)

indexes.name: appointments_calendar
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX appointments_calendar ON public.appointments USING btree (location_id, blocked_from)

indexes.name: appointments_staff_day
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX appointments_staff_day ON public.appointments USING btree (staff_id, blocked_from)

indexes.name: appointments_client
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX appointments_client ON public.appointments USING btree (client_id, starts_at DESC)

indexes.name: no_staff_double_booking
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX no_staff_double_booking ON public.appointments USING gist (staff_id, tstzrange(blocked_from, blocked_until)) WHERE (status <> ALL (ARRAY['cancelled'::text, 'no_show'::text]))

indexes.name: no_room_double_booking
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX no_room_double_booking ON public.appointments USING gist (resource_id, tstzrange(blocked_from, blocked_until)) WHERE ((status <> ALL (ARRAY['cancelled'::text, 'no_show'::text])) AND (resource_id IS NOT NULL))

constraints.name: no_staff_double_booking
constraints.def: EXCLUDE USING gist (staff_id WITH =, tstzrange(blocked_from, blocked_until) WITH &&) WHERE ((status <> ALL (ARRAY['cancelled'::text, 'no_show'::text])))

constraints.name: no_room_double_booking
constraints.def: EXCLUDE USING gist (resource_id WITH =, tstzrange(blocked_from, blocked_until) WITH &&) WHERE (((status <> ALL (ARRAY['cancelled'::text, 'no_show'::text])) AND (resource_id IS NOT NULL)))

triggers.name: trg_appointments_touch
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER trg_appointments_touch BEFORE UPDATE ON public.appointments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION touch_updated_at()

triggers.name: trg_no_show_counter
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER trg_no_show_counter AFTER UPDATE ON public.appointments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION maintain_no_show_count()

tables.name: public.appointment_services
tables.comment: Line items with name/price/duration SNAPSHOTS taken at booking: catalog edits never rewrite booked history.

indexes.name: appointment_services_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX appointment_services_pkey ON public.appointment_services USING btree (id)

indexes.name: appointment_services_appt
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX appointment_services_appt ON public.appointment_services USING btree (appointment_id)

constraints.name: appointment_services_appointment_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (appointment_id) REFERENCES appointments(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.name: public.notifications
tables.comment: In-app notifications. Created ONLY by triggers/service role (no authenticated insert policy). RLS scopes reads and mark-read to the recipient — including over Realtime, which is published for this table.

indexes.name: notifications_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX notifications_pkey ON public.notifications USING btree (id)

indexes.name: notifications_staff
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX notifications_staff ON public.notifications USING btree (staff_id, created_at DESC)

indexes.name: notifications_unread
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX notifications_unread ON public.notifications USING btree (staff_id) WHERE (read_at IS NULL)

constraints.name: notifications_staff_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (staff_id) REFERENCES staff(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.name: public.products
tables.comment: Retail catalog (lotions, candles, ...). Stock decremented by trigger on sale. cost_cents enables margin reporting. Deactivated, never deleted.

indexes.name: products_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX products_pkey ON public.products USING btree (id)

indexes.name: products_organization_id_name_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX products_organization_id_name_key ON public.products USING btree (organization_id, name)

triggers.name: trg_products_touch
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER trg_products_touch BEFORE UPDATE ON public.products FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION touch_updated_at()

tables.name: public.gift_cards
tables.comment: Balance maintained by triggers: created/loaded by a gift_card SALE item, decremented by a gift_card PAYMENT. Balance can never go negative (trigger).

indexes.name: gift_cards_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX gift_cards_pkey ON public.gift_cards USING btree (id)

indexes.name: gift_cards_code_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX gift_cards_code_key ON public.gift_cards USING btree (code)

tables.name: public.transactions
tables.comment: The immutable money ledger: one row per checkout. NEVER updated or deleted (no policies exist). Refunds are new rows with negative amounts referencing the original via refunds_transaction_id. All financial reporting reads from here.

indexes.name: transactions_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX transactions_pkey ON public.transactions USING btree (id)

indexes.name: transactions_org_day
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX transactions_org_day ON public.transactions USING btree (organization_id, created_at DESC)

indexes.name: transactions_client
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX transactions_client ON public.transactions USING btree (client_id, created_at DESC)

tables.name: public.transaction_items
tables.comment: Line items with name/price SNAPSHOTS (catalog edits never rewrite sold history). kind=service carries appointment + staff attribution; kind=tip carries staff attribution for payroll reads; kind=discount is negative; kind=gift_card is a liability sale, excluded from revenue reporting.

indexes.name: transaction_items_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX transaction_items_pkey ON public.transaction_items USING btree (id)

indexes.name: transaction_items_txn
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX transaction_items_txn ON public.transaction_items USING btree (transaction_id)

indexes.name: transaction_items_staff
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX transaction_items_staff ON public.transaction_items USING btree (staff_id) WHERE (staff_id IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: transaction_items_transaction_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (transaction_id) REFERENCES transactions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

triggers.name: trg_product_sale
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER trg_product_sale AFTER INSERT ON public.transaction_items FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION apply_product_sale()

tables.name: public.payments
tables.comment: How each transaction settled. Multiple rows = split tender ("$80 gift card + rest on card"). card_external = charged on the spa's existing physical terminal and recorded here; in-app charging arrives with Stripe (4b).

indexes.name: payments_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payments_pkey ON public.payments USING btree (id)

indexes.name: payments_txn
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX payments_txn ON public.payments USING btree (transaction_id)

constraints.name: payments_transaction_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (transaction_id) REFERENCES transactions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

triggers.name: trg_gift_card_payment
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER trg_gift_card_payment AFTER INSERT ON public.payments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION apply_gift_card_payment()

tables.name: public.conversations
tables.comment: DMs and ad-hoc group chats. updated_at is bumped by every message (list sort key). Append-only messaging: no edit/delete in v1.

indexes.name: conversations_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX conversations_pkey ON public.conversations USING btree (id)

tables.name: public.conversation_participants
tables.comment: Membership + read state. last_read_at is the unread mechanism: unread = messages newer than it. Rows are created only by the conversation functions (security definer).

indexes.name: conversation_participants_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX conversation_participants_pkey ON public.conversation_participants USING btree (conversation_id, staff_id)

indexes.name: conversation_participants_staff
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX conversation_participants_staff ON public.conversation_participants USING btree (staff_id)

constraints.name: conversation_participants_staff_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (staff_id) REFERENCES staff(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: conversation_participants_conversation_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.name: public.messages
tables.comment: Append-only (no update/delete policies). Org-scoped through the parent conversation (transaction_items precedent). Published to realtime; RLS limits delivery to participants.

indexes.name: messages_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX messages_pkey ON public.messages USING btree (id)

indexes.name: messages_conversation
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX messages_conversation ON public.messages USING btree (conversation_id, created_at DESC)

constraints.name: messages_conversation_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

triggers.name: trg_message_bumps_conversation
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER trg_message_bumps_conversation AFTER INSERT ON public.messages FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION message_bumps_conversation()

triggers.name: trg_notify_message_received
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER trg_notify_message_received AFTER INSERT ON public.messages FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION notify_message_received()
